notes: Web 407 — REVENUE-DETAIL-STRIP-NOV10 + DISPATCH-TAP-ROUTES-TO-PTI-NOV10 (Nov 10, 2026): two owner items from the morning, one ship. (1) THE STRIP (modules/revenue.js): the owner opened a Revenue day detail, found the day's Fuel fills, tracker Sessions and Dispatches on it, and ruled (11:27): that whole-day picture is exactly the job of the Manifest — delete it from here, it is extra information. renderDayDetail no longer paints those sections (ticket photos went with them); the Revenue day detail shows the day's REVENUE only — totals, money entries, the Also recorded (not counted) revenue records with their Edit/Delete, and extras. dayDetailData still assembles the sessions/fuel/dispatches lists (the data benches pin them); the renderer simply never paints them, and the Manifest module's own day view is untouched — the whole-day picture lives there. Named consequence, per the ruling: the v319 session-record Delete door existed only in this renderer and is gone with the section; saveSessionsVerified is now unused in revenue.js (left in place). The Nov 8 audit-entry suite's Revenue-detail photo assertions are superseded by this ruling and flipped to absence assertions (36 passed / 0 failed); the picture's home is the Manifest day view, pinned by the new strip suite. (2) THE HIJACK (js/app.js + modules/pti.js): the owner's 07:25 screen recording — he tapped the Dispatch dashboard card and was forced into the PTI Vehicle Inspection Reports officer view, and his only exit was its orange Exit Inspection Mode button. Convicted: the v165 DOT Inspection Mode lock — openModule rewrites any non-'pti' key to 'pti' while dotLockActive() reads the stored pti_dot.active, and showDashboard routes there too. pti_dot is an ordinary SYNCED store record (cloudsync takes every key not starting with __) with no freshness bound and no on-screen signal, so an activation minted days earlier (the Nov 5 roadside stop) or re-landed from the cloud sprang on the next module tap. Fix: the lock binds only a FRESH activation — Begin Inspection now stamps since (modules/pti.js), and both readers (the shell's dotLockActive and PTI's own dotActive, each carrying its own copy of the bound, DOT_LOCK_MAX_MS = 12h) honor only a stamp inside the bound; a stale or unstamped activation self-heals on shell contact (writes back active:false, preserving other keys — the cleared state syncs and un-arms other clients) and never paints the officer view. The two v165 call-site lines are byte-identical, and a genuine fresh Inspection Mode still locks exactly as designed. The missing-PTI nudge itself (dashboard flag + once-a-day sheet) never navigated and is unchanged. Benches: tools/revenue-detail-strip-nov10-test.js failing-first 11 passed / 5 failed (the 5 = exactly the strip assertions) → 16/16; tools/dispatch-tap-pti-gate-nov10-test.js failing-first 19 passed / 12 failed (field repro: tapping Dispatch opens DISPATCH — got 'pti') → 31/31.
